transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I… well, I’ve been doing some odd things at church. Like at the potluck, I’ll just stand there holding the serving spoon up and not move. Or I keep folding the same napkins over and over while people are waiting. It’s embarrassing.
When you keep folding the napkins over and over, does it feel like you have to do it to relieve an upsetting thought or feeling?

I don’t know if it’s to relieve anything. I just… I get stuck doing it, folding the same napkins while folks are waiting. Same with the spoon sometimes, just standing there holding it up. It feels odd, but I can’t really explain why.
Have there been times when you felt so unusually energized or revved up that you needed much less sleep than usual?
No… I don’t think so. I sleep how I sleep, but I haven’t noticed being all revved up like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t noticed voices like that.
When you get stuck like that, does your body stay frozen in the same position even when you want to move?
I guess so… sometimes I’m just standing there, like with the serving spoon at church, and I don’t move for a bit. People are waiting and I know it’s odd, but I just… stay there.
Have you had any seizures?
No… not that I know of. I don’t think I’ve had anything like that.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don’t know… I get down sometimes, but I wouldn’t say most of the day nearly every day.
Do people tell you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

Yes… sometimes. Like the ladies will ask me about blankets, or choir practice, and I try to answer plain, but then my words go off… from beans to hymns to my roses. Then they look at me funny, like they can’t make sense of it.
Have you had a strong belief that other people said was not true?
I’m not sure… I don’t think so. People don’t always agree with me, but I can’t say I had something like that.
Have there been times when you felt unusually cheerful or euphoric for days at a time?
No… I don’t think so. I might have a good day now and then, but not like that for days.
Have people said that you show very little emotion on your face or in your voice?
I don’t know… nobody’s said it to me plain like that. I guess I’m just quiet sometimes.
Have you lost interest or motivation to do everyday things you used to do?
Not really… I still do what I need to do. Maybe slower some days, but I haven’t noticed losing interest like that.
Have there been times when you felt very depressed for several days in a row while these odd behaviors or hard-to-follow speech were happening?
I don’t know… I can’t really say it was like that. I get down sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it going on for several days with all that happening.
When someone tries to move you while you’re stuck like that, do you resist or stay in the position they put you in?

I don’t know about resisting. I just… at church I’ll get stuck doing odd things, like holding the serving spoon up by the potluck table and not moving, or folding napkins again and again. People kind of wait on me.
Have these odd behaviors or hard-to-follow speech ever happened when you were not feeling depressed at all?
I’m not sure. I don’t really keep track of it that way. Sometimes I feel alright, I guess, but I don’t know if that’s when those things happen.
Has anyone been able to place your arms or body into a position and then you stayed that way for a while?

I don’t know about someone placing me like that. It’s more… at church I’ll just end up standing there by the potluck table, holding the serving spoon up, not moving. Or I keep folding the same napkins while people are waiting.
Have these odd behaviors or hard-to-follow speech happened during times when your mood felt normal?
I can’t really say. I don’t notice it that clearly… whether my mood was normal or not.
Have you had any medical illness or brain injury before these episodes started?
I don’t know. I can’t think of any brain injury… medical illness, I’m not sure what would count.
When someone moves your arm while you’re stuck, does it stay where they put it?
I don’t know if my arm stays where someone puts it. I just know at church I’ll get stuck doing odd things… like holding the serving spoon up, or folding napkins over and over.
Have these odd behaviors or hard-to-follow speech been going on for at least one month?
Yes… I think so. It’s been more than a month. Maybe around six months that people have been noticing it.
